title: ScamGraph Message Record Schema
description: Canonical representation of a single message data point with complete provenance and scam classification metadata.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier in format SOURCE-TYPE-HASH (e.g., SG-MSG-000001)

text.description: Raw message text (SMS, WhatsApp, email, etc.)

label.description: Ground truth label: scam or legitimate

language.description: Language and script: 'en' (English), 'hi' (Hindi), 'hinglish' (mixed), or regional-English code-mix

provenance.description: Data provenance: real-world, synthetically generated, or mixed

review_status.description: Human audit status. Only 'approved' records should be used for training.

label_confidence.description: Confidence in label (0.0 to 1.0). Lower values indicate ambiguous or low-confidence labels.

campaign_template_id.description: If part of a known scam campaign, the template ID (e.g., 'fake_kyc_template_04')

signals.description: Behavioral or linguistic signals that contribute to the classification

journey_id.description: If part of a multi-stage journey, the journey ID (e.g., 'SG-JOURNEY-001')

journey_stage.description: Stage number in a multi-stage journey (1 = initial contact, 2 = verification, etc.)

collection_date.description: Date and time of data collection or creation

is_synthetic.description: True if synthetically generated; false if real-world data

privacy_status.description: Privacy status. 'redacted' or 'anonymous' for real user data.

duplicate_group_id.description: If this record is a duplicate or variant of another, the group ID (e.g., 'DUP-GROUP-42')
